integrity_notes: Algebraic identities and strict parameter inequalities are proved in RESULT.md; the independent spectral calculation is supporting numerical corroboration. Original state preparation and the CHSH criterion are cited prior work. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the two-qubit transverse-field Ising Hamiltonian with joint Poisson resets to the initial product state and no other environment is considered.
The unique sqrt(5) maximum is proved within the inverse-coupling scaled reset family, not globally over all finite parameters.
Only a sufficient finite-coupling CHSH violation region is established; the entire finite-parameter Bell phase boundary is not determined.
No detector-noise robustness or fixed-observable CHSH claim is made.
title: Bell nonlocality in a strong-coupling quantum-reset window
